head: Pale leaves
text: Your pechay leaves are turning pale.

head: Complete?
text: So you buy a sack of complete fertilizer.

head: Complete?
text: Nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. All three.

head: Only one
text: But your soil may be short of only one.

head: Leyte soils
text: In Leyte, six in ten farms already have plenty of potassium.

head: Wasted
text: Buy more, and that money is wasted.

head: Nitrogen
text: Pale leaves usually point to nitrogen.

head: Nitrogen
text: It keeps leaves green, and leafy crops like pechay need the most.

head: Probe
text: Push the SakaSense probe into moist soil, about ten centimeters deep.

head: Five spots
text: Take five readings across the bed.

head: N · P · K
text: The screen shows your nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium.

head: Code 4
text: Plus one simple code. Here, code four: nitrogen low.

head: The fix
text: Open Kasaka, and code four gives you the exact fix.

head: 50 grams
text: Just fifty grams of urea per bed. About five tablespoons.

head: Skip
text: Phosphorus and potassium are already good. Skip them.

head: Green again
text: Then watch your pechay turn green again.

head: Test first, then buy
text: SakaSense and the Kasaka app. Test first, then buy.
